answer: No, in Virginia your dad doesn't need a notary. You can sell his car for him if he gives you a power of attorney. The older notarized form, NW-POA-1, was replaced on February 1, 2026 by form NW-POA-2, which he can sign electronically with no notary. Notarization is still required only in Georgia. An NW-POA-1 signed before February 1 was accepted only until June 30, 2026, so it can't be used now. When you come in, bring the signed form, your own photo ID and the car's documents.
